name: Johan Herschel
source:
Affiliation: Magic Institute
Hobby: Taking Naps
Special Skill: Croquette
Likes: Books
Dislikes: Mice

A magician that manages the Magic Institute.
A kind person who is admired by all his students.
He's always studying and experimenting to broaden his knowledge of magic.
His dream is to make everybody happy by the power of magic.
But he has a terrible sleep schedule and can't cook or clean by himself, so that is all left up to Unisys.
